about:
Premier Improvements Solar operates from West Hartford, Connecticut, where it has served residential customers for over two decades. The company is veteran-owned, with owner Brian leading a team that includes project managers, installers, and customer-service representatives. Founded on a passion for solar energy, the business began as a local installer focused on helping Connecticut homeowners reduce rising electricity costs.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy systems: custom-designed photovoltaic installations, battery backup storage using FranklinWH A2 and Tesla Powerwall units, and full roof replacement using Owens Corning Duration® shingles with WeatherLock® protection. It also offers combined roof-and-solar packages and assists customers with CT Green Bank Smart-E Loan financing. To date, the company has completed more than 1,000 solar installations across the state.

Premier Improvements Solar works exclusively with homeowners throughout Connecticut, delivering residential solar power, energy storage, and roofing solutions. Its customer base includes families seeking to lower utility bills, achieve energy independence during grid outages, and take advantage of state incentives such as battery rebates up to $16,000.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned status, 25-year comprehensive warranties on equipment and workmanship, and a no-pressure sales approach. As an approved Smart-E Loan provider and a certified installer for both Tesla Powerwall and FranklinWH systems, it positions itself as a single-source partner for home energy upgrades.
